# Burkina Faso

> [!summary] Data available
> Thin on food (2 [[World Wide Dishes]] dishes, 4 [[WorldCuisines]]) but relatively strong on ethnobotany: [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] has 369 records (as Upper Volta). The West African FCT is inside the FAO/INFOODS candidate; compounds via [[NPASS]] (65 pairs) and [[Global]].

## Foods & dishes
- [[World Wide Dishes]]: 2 dishes, both Burkina-only (babenda, Mossi, Central Plateau); free-text ingredients, no amounts or method, plus eating context (time of day, occasion, utensils, local-language name).
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 4 dishes, none Burkina-only.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national FCT is in the vault. The [[FAO INFOODS global databases]] candidate (priority 2, directory of 308 tables) includes the FAO/INFOODS **West African Food Composition Table (WAFCT)**, a regional table for the ECOWAS countries including Burkina Faso; processing it is the most direct way to get local foods (fonio, cowpea, shea, baobab, leafy sauces). Until then, use [[USDA FoodData Central]] by name matching.
- [[CMAUP]]: 94 plants; [[NPASS]]: 65 pairs (2 species, 49 compounds).

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 369 ethnobotany records (84 taxa), all from Ayensu (gonorrhoea, leprosy, fever, headache, dysentery).
- [[KNApSAcK Family]] lists Burkina Faso on its World map, but African flag pages were not scraped (counts unknown).
- Compound → effect chains come from the global backbone via [[Global]] ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions).

## Gaps
- Almost no dish data; staples (tô, soumbala, dolo) are not in any food dataset.
- WAFCT not yet processed.
